def bresenham(p1, p2):
    r1, c1 = p1
    r2, c2 = p2
    pts = set()
    dx = abs(c2 - c1)
    dy = abs(r2 - r1)
    
    if r1 == r2:
        for c in range(min(c1,c2), max(c1,c2) + 1):
            pts.add((r1, c))
        return pts
    if c1 == c2:
        for r in range(min(r1,r2), max(r1,r2) + 1):
            pts.add((r, c1))
        return pts
    
    sr = 1 if r2 > r1 else -1
    sc = 1 if c2 > c1 else -1

            pts.add((r, c))
